sections.title: Patterns you are too close to see
body: Sensei watches sessions locally. When the same correction keeps happening, it forms a finding and offers one action: apply, review or dismiss.
sections.caption: A finding card offering apply, review, or dismiss.

sections.title: A memory becomes a rule
body: A learning that keeps proving itself can be promoted to a rule at a higher scope, from your repository to your project or team.
sections.caption: A rule climbing from repository to shared team rule.

sections.title: The dōjō loop
body: For teams, a shared dōjō runs one loop: bind a project, contribute a finding, have maintainers triage and approve it, and distribute approved knowledge back by scope.
points: Client work anonymized before it can leave
High-impact changes need a second approval
sections.caption: Three chips circling the dōjō: contribute, triage, distribute.

sections.title: The Sensei idea
body: Define quality, measure the right things, know the failure modes, build good habits, and turn standards into rules the assistant actually loads. Next week: Gateway, routing across model providers.
sections.caption: Three repeated fixes funnelling into one shared rule.
